'Charges for services' 27,288 split (Fire rentals 4,600 p17, Park rentals 13,362 and hay sales 2,090 p18, pool fees 4,986 p19, Cemetery grave openings 2,250 p23). 'Other receipts' 41,436 split (General dept 12,631 p15, Fire 612 p17, Pool 3,935 p19, Sales Tax 2,990 p22, Cemetery 4,000 p23, CDBG 8,498 p24, CDA sale of property 8,460 p27, Forestry 310 p28). Business-type from the basic modified-cash proprietary statement (p8, Total column; ties to government-wide net position 1,032,333); disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenses 436,462 (p2); receipts = operating 450,042 + interest 121 (no single printed total).
